summary:
Complete architectural overhaul of Jules AGY delivering all 6 cutting-edge pillars:
1. Real-time Multimodal Live Copilot ("Jarvis" experience via WebSockets, bidirectional PCM audio, camera streaming, and real-time tool calling).
2. Context-Aware "Infinite Memory" Brain (Gemini 1.5 Pro local RAG synthesizing Room DB notes, phrases, itineraries, and 2M token context metrics).
3. Agentic Tool Calling (AGY Nexus with Room DB hooks, Google Maps GPS navigation intents, device telemetry, and MCP app launching).
4. Immersive AR Translation & World Lens (CameraX HUD, holographic reticle, Menu Scanner with dietary/allergen alerts, and Culture Lens).
5. Advanced Creation Studio (Imagen 3 & Veo 3.1 studio with Gemini Magic prompt expander, style presets, negative prompts, and aspect ratio selector).
6. Next-Gen Cyberpunk / Glassmorphism UI (Dark cyber surfaces, glowing neon cyan/violet/pink accents, animated waveforms, radar rings, and ambient glow).
